matchup.title: Matchup 2: Come-in Cider vs Team Nic Kerr
matchup.plan_md:
We trail **806 to 927** after Thursday. Our Thursday produced 51 against a projected 99 (their 193 against 190), because Dejounte Murray was a late scratch for the birth of his son. As rostered we project **1,437 to 1,674**. If VanVleet sits Saturday, as he did on the second night of Houston's last back-to-back, that drops to 1,403 (a `--sit` run).

**Even the best plan (+66.3) leaves us about 170 behind**, so the move to make is the one that also helps next week:

| # | US day | Deadline, Melbourne (ET) | Move |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Fri 30 | **10:30 am Sat 31** (7:30 pm Fri) | Drop CJ McCollum, add **Ja'Kobe Walter** (TOR). +30.8 this week |

- **Walter:** 34.0 FP/g over 4 games; L7 35.0 (3), L15 34.0 (4), L30 34.0 (4); 26.5 minutes.
  - He has started 2 of 4, both since Kawhi Leonard went out, and plays Friday and Sunday, then 3 games next week.
  - The role lasts while Leonard is out: the Raptors re-evaluate him about 3 Nov, and Chris Haynes reports "at least 3-4 weeks" (*ESPN est.* 23 Nov).
- **McCollum:** 25.2 over 6 games; L7 24.2 (5), L15 25.2 (6), L30 25.2 (6). He plays only Saturday this week, then 4 games next week.
- **To chase instead** (*Rotating* section): 3 adds, +66.3. Each move is due by the earlier tip-off of the two players that day:
  - **Fri** (by 10:30 am Sat Melbourne): McCollum → **Norman Powell** (CHI; 32.2; L7 34.5 (4), L15 32.2 (5), L30 32.2 (5); started 5 of 5).
  - **Sat** (by 11:00 am Sun): Powell → **Precious Achiuwa** (SAC; 34.4; L7 34.2 (4), L15 34.4 (5), L30 34.4 (5); started 3 of 5).
  - **Sun** (by 1:00 pm Mon): Achiuwa → Walter.

  It ends holding Walter too, but leaves him on the wire until Sunday at 18% owned.
- **Hold VanVleet, Murphy and Kawhi** while our three trade offers are pending. Every offer includes VanVleet and Murphy, so dropping either voids them.
- **Lineups:**
  - Friday: 9 of ours play for 10 slots, 10 with Walter.
  - Saturday and Sunday: 6–7 open slots.
  - Start everyone with a game.
- **Swing factors:**
  - **Fred VanVleet** (ours): sits one game of Friday–Saturday. Houston hasn't said which; Saturday is likelier.
  - **Dejounte Murray** (ours): a game-time decision for Saturday against Atlanta. Personal reasons, no timetable reported; *ESPN est.* 31 Oct.
  - **Ja Morant** (theirs): a left hamstring "twinge"; questionable for Saturday at Utah. No timetable reported; *ESPN est.* 31 Oct.
  - **Chet Holmgren** (theirs): patellar tendinitis; Saturday at Houston is undecided. No timetable reported; *ESPN est.* 31 Oct.
  - **Kawhi Leonard** (ours): out. Re-evaluated about 3 Nov; *ESPN est.* 23 Nov.

### Notes

- **Ja Morant** left Thursday's loss to Memphis in the fourth quarter. Micah Nori called it a twinge and expects more information Friday [TSN, 30 Oct](https://www.tsn.ca/nba/article/trail-blazers-morant-exits-first-game-vs-grizzlies-with-hamstring-injury-n1-50325662/) [CBS Sports, 30 Oct](https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/trail-blazers-ja-morant-departs-with-hamstring-issue/).
- **Chet Holmgren** has missed two games. OKC is idle until Saturday at Houston and had not filed its report [CBS Sports, 27 Oct](https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/thunders-chet-holmgren-wont-play-wednesday-536384/) [NBA injury report, 30 Oct 01:00 ET](https://ak-static.cms.nba.com/referee/injury/Injury-Report_2026-10-30_01_00AM.pdf).
- **Luka Doncic** is off the injury report for Friday at Golden State [NBC Sports, 29 Oct](https://www.nbcsports.com/fantasy/basketball/player-news/2026-10-29/luka-doncic-back-off-injury-report-vs-gsw).
- **Rest risk:** Tyrese Maxey, Jabari Smith Jr. and Moussa Diabate each played both nights of their team's last back-to-back, and none is on Friday's report [NBA injury report, 30 Oct 01:00 ET](https://ak-static.cms.nba.com/referee/injury/Injury-Report_2026-10-30_01_00AM.pdf).
- **Fred VanVleet** is not on Friday's report. Udoka sits him one game of each back-to-back early in the season [CBS Sports, 20 Oct](https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/rockets-fred-vanvleet-to-miss-back-to-backs/). Last time he played the first night (23 Oct) and sat the second [Basketball-Reference](https://www.basketball-reference.com/players/v/vanvlfr01/gamelog/2027).
- **Dejounte Murray:** Mosley said "we look forward to having him back soon" [CBS Sports, 29 Oct](https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/pelicans-dejounte-murray-late-scratch-thursday/) [SSBCrack, 29 Oct](https://news.ssbcrack.com/dejounte-murray-misses-game-for-birth-of-son-as-pelicans-face-kings/).
- **Norman Powell** has started all five games, with 37 minutes and 30 points on Wednesday. No returning player threatens his spot [Basketball-Reference](https://www.basketball-reference.com/players/p/powelno01/gamelog/2027).
- **Grayson Allen** comes off the bench for 28–34 minutes and starts if Dennis Schroder (questionable, foot) sits [NBC Sports, 29 Oct](https://www.nbcsports.com/fantasy/basketball/player-news/2026-10-29/dennis-schroder-foot-questionable-vs-washington).
- **Payton Pritchard, Brook Lopez and Obi Toppin** all come off the bench with flat minutes [Basketball-Reference](https://www.basketball-reference.com/teams/BOS/2027_start.html).
- **Precious Achiuwa** and **Ja'Kobe Walter:** see the Injury Watch shortlist (`docs/analysis/20261030-injury-watch.md`).
